Hi Natalie —

Thanks again for the time earlier. To keep momentum toward signing, suggested next step: a two-part working session where we (AE + SE + Legal + Procurement) walk through the latest SOW items and the customer redlines, then finish with a short demo of the configuration we referenced. Proposed agenda (60–75 minutes):

- 0–10m quick intros & objectives (AE)
- 10–40m redline review (Legal / Procurement / AE) — focus on data residency, audit logs, and SLA language
- 40–65m SE demo showing sample latency/cost profile for your workloads
- 65–75m next steps & signoff items

I attached the latest SOW (WaveOptics_SOW_v3.docx) and a one-page redline summary (redline_notes_v1.pdf) so folks can scan before we meet.

Can you share a few 30–75m windows this week or early next week that include your procurement and engineering leads? Our immediate priority is clearing the two open clauses so procurement can finalize budget approval.

If helpful I can also loop in Rishi for any leadership approvals if you foresee a commercial exception.

Thanks —
